name: Satin Creditcare Network Ltd
title: Satin Creditcare Network Ltd - 539404 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Satin's MFI stress is easing: FY26 credit cost 3.8% (down 77bp) and Q4 consolidated 2.2%, but management gave no supply-side signals and guidance is standalone AUM growth of 15–20%.

utilisation.quote: Our sourcing to disbursement ratio of 39% reflects genuine selectivity.

triggers.label: Consolidated credit cost Q4 2.2%
triggers.quote: Credit cost at consolidated level for quarter 4 was 2.2% in terms of percentages.

triggers.label: Standalone credit cost guided 3–3.5% FY27
triggers.quote: Credit cost target of 3% to 3.5%, a meaningf ul improvement from 3.8% in FY 26.

triggers.label: Consolidated AUM target raised to INR32,000 cr
triggers.quote: revising our long -term AUM target upward from INR25,000 crores to INR32,000 crores by 2030

triggers.label: Incremental MFI yield ~25%, rate cap risk

guidance.quote: our standalone guidance is AUM growth of 15% to 20% year-on-year, implying an AUM of approximately IN R14,800 crores to INR15,100 crores.
Credit cost target of 3% to 3.5%, a meaningf ul improvement from 3.8% in FY 26.
revising our long -term AUM target upward from INR25,000 crores to INR32,000 crores by 2030
with a non -MFI AUM target of 30% by that date
it consolidates into about 13% -average 12% to 13% is what it is.

red_flags.label: Treasury/FX gains inflating Q4 top line
red_flags.quote: net gain on derecognition of financial instruments, something around INR144 crores

red_flags.label: Standalone NW inflated by old revaluation
red_flags.quote: the standalone net worth has gone up, but on a consolidated basis, that revaluation impact is removed

red_flags.label: Management declined ROA guidance and yield questions
red_flags.quote: We don't want to give a guidance to be very honest

evasions.quote: I will not be able to give you a clear guidance on ROA.
It is holding on. I think I will not be able to give you specific
So there is no question where I think it could be singled out as in terms of tax and it's an interest rate play which is going to be there.
